rv.q: "The familiar Ross hits that punctuate the score, including “Endless Love” and the theme from Mahogany, have the unfortunate effect of upstaging the musical’s serviceable original songs, whose tunes are fine delivery systems for the lyrics but rarely catch strong melodic wind.

Librettist/lyricist Dan Collins and composer Julianne Wick Davis have fleshed out Celeste Lecesne's story about a middle-school lad grappling with his sexuality in 1981 suburbia, and turned it into a show that is at once breezily entertaining and genuinely heartwarming.

"For the Trevor advent, we also have to thank the increasing belief abroad in the musical theater community that any play or movie ever made is fodder for musicalization. I’m not going to insist the contention is wrong. It seems to me that if the right inspired people apply themselves to a property, they can produce something memorable.
